# dear-skills

> Personal skills for personal automation, in the open Agent Skills format. Each skill ships as a recipe with no personal data, is customised for the user at first install, and keeps its memory in the user's own OneDrive.

## For agents
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saju01/dear-skills/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents working in or installing from this repo
- [INSTALL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saju01/dear-skills/main/INSTALL.md): step-by-step agent-led installation
- [install.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saju01/dear-skills/main/install.json): machine-readable manifest (files, sha256, hosts, adapters, requirements)

## Skills
- dear-inbox-zero: mail, calendar and Teams triage that learns from what the user does; drafts only, never sends. Lite mode: mail only, no Python. Design: [DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saju01/dear-skills/main/DESIGN.md)
